tech.summary: Google DeepMind ne 10 November ko AlphaProof Code introduce kiya — aik agentic framework jis mein AI agents ne Signal ke libsignal code ki key security properties ko Lean mein machine-checked proofs se verify kiya. Agents ne chaar hafton mein 6.5 million lines ki proof likhi — aisa kaam jo expert teams ko saalon lagta tha. Proof mein post-quantum PQXDH handshake aur Triple Ratchet shamil hain, aur team ne do purani fixed bugs wapas daal kar check kiya ke system buggy code ko pakar leta hai. Artifacts open-source kar diye gaye hain. Scope yaad rakhein: ye poori Signal app ka certificate nahi, core crypto code ka hai — group chats aur key generation abhi bahar hain.
tech.title: DeepMind ka AlphaProof Code — Signal ki cryptography ab maths se prove ho gayi

tech.summary: Google DeepMind ne 10 November ko Gemini Robotics 2.5 launch kiya — apna sab se capable vision-language-action model. Apptronik ke Apollo 2 humanoid ne Mercedes-Benz ke Kecskemét (Hungary) aur Sindelfingen (Germany) plants par live production lines par automotive kitting ki — metal parts ko bins se nikaal kar sahi order mein trays mein rakhna — 96% success rate ke saath. DeepMind ke mutabiq 200+ tasks par success 30% se 100% tak barhi aur kaam 20-30% tez hua. Saath mein ASIMOV-Jailbreak benchmark bhi release hua, jo test karta hai ke robot ko dhoke se khatarnak kaam par majboor to nahi kiya ja sakta.
tech.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 — robot ab Mercedes ki factory line par kaam kar raha hai

tech.summary: Anthropic ne 10 November ko apne IPO ka roadshow shuru kar diya: 825 million shares $70 se $78 per share, Nasdaq par ticker ANT. CNBC ke mutabiq pricing 18 November aur trading 19 November se expected hai. Range ke top par raise lagbhag $64.35 billion banta hai aur company ki fully diluted value taqreeban $1.4 trillion — May ki $965 billion valuation se bara jump. Saath mein Google, Nvidia aur AMD jaisi companies se $26 billion ka private placement bhi hai, aur Anthropic taqreeban 20% shares retail investors ke liye rakhna chahta hai — aam tor par 5-10% hota hai.
tech.title: Anthropic IPO ki price tay — $70 se $78, $64 billion tak ka raise

tech.summary: OpenAI ne 10 November ko 'Businesses in ChatGPT' beta mein launch kiya. Naye Business Hub mein companies apna profile claim kar ke verify karwa sakti hain, products aur services ki details update kar sakti hain aur product feeds de sakti hain — bilkul Google Business Profile ki tarah. Eligible businesses apna 'Business Agent' bhi bana sakti hain, jis se users ChatGPT ke andar hi us business se sawal-jawab kar sakein. Hub ye bhi batayega ke ChatGPT users ne business ko kitni dafa mention kiya ya us ki website par click kiya. Shuruaat mein sirf eligible US ecommerce aur online-service businesses ke liye hai.
tech.title: ChatGPT ab Google jaisa ban raha hai — businesses ke verified profiles aur agents

tech.summary: Chinese company Meituan ne 9 November ko apne LongCat-2.5 model ke weights Hugging Face par MIT license ke tehat release kar diye. Ye aik multimodal agent model hai jo screenshots aur video dekh kar codebase parh sakta hai aur multi-step coding kar sakta hai — 1.6 trillion total parameters, taqreeban 48 billion active per token, 1 million token context. Meituan ke mutabiq is ne Terminal-Bench v2.1 par 88.4 score kiya. Lekin self-hosting aasan nahi: weights hi 3.2TB se zyada jagah lete hain, matlab cluster chahiye. Aur ye saare benchmark scores company ke apne hain — independent testing abhi baqi hai.
tech.title: Meituan ne LongCat-2.5 ke weights khol diye — 1.6 trillion parameters, MIT license

pakistan.summary: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa ki administration ne faceless anti-terrorism courts banane ka plan tayyar kar liya hai, taa ke dehshatgardi ke cases mein gawah, prosecutor aur judge ki pehchan chhupi rahe — Dawn ki report ke mutabiq Home Secretary Amjad Ali Khan ne ye briefing di. Plan mein police ke liye Rs59.8 billion aur Counter Terrorism Department ke liye Rs10.3 billion saalana bhi shamil hain, Safe City ki tausia, anti-drone systems aur 10,000 se zyada police ki kami poori karna bhi. Ye emergency aur governor's rule ke taqreeban aik mahine baad ka naya security plan hai.
pakistan.title: KP mein faceless anti-terror courts ka plan — police aur CTD ke liye Rs70bn

pakistan.summary: PCB ne Pakistan aur Sri Lanka ke darmiyan doosra Test Lahore se Rawalpindi shift kar diya hai. Match 17 se 21 November tak Gaddafi Stadium mein hona tha, ab Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium mein hoga. Wajah: Lahore mein 10 din se shadeed smog, AQI 600 tak pahunch gaya hai. Dono Tests ab aik hi ground par honge. Pehle Test mein Pakistan ne 434/9 par declare kiya — Saud Shakeel ne 93 banaye — aur Sri Lanka apni doosri innings mein 114/3 par tha jab roshni kam hone par khel ruka.
pakistan.title: Smog ne doosra Test bhi Rawalpindi bhej diya — Lahore ki AQI 600 tak

pakistan.summary: Deputy Prime Minister aur Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar ne Islamabad mein Margalla Dialogue 2026 ke iftatahi session mein kaha ke Saudi Arabia aur Turkiye ke saath Makkah Joint Defence Agreement aik defensive arrangement hai jo kisi mulk ke khilaf nahi aur regional peace ke liye hai. Unhon ne kaha ke Pakistan Indus Waters Treaty ke tehat apne paani ke huqooq ki hifazat karega aur paani ko hathiyaar banane ki kisi koshish ki mukhalfat karega. Dar ne Afghan sarzameen se dehshatgardi, Gaza ki surat-e-haal aur badalte hue global order par bhi baat ki.
pakistan.title: Dar ne Margalla Dialogue mein kaha — Makkah defence pact kisi ke khilaf nahi, paani ko hathiyaar nahi banne denge

pakistan.summary: State Bank of Pakistan ke mutabiq overseas Pakistanis ne October 2026 mein $3.89 billion bheje — pichle saal ke $3.42 billion se 13.8% zyada, aur September se 8.5% zyada. July se October tak total $14.8 billion ho gaya, pichle saal ke $13 billion se 14% zyada. Sab se bara source Saudi Arabia raha ($982m), phir UAE ($816m) aur UK ($592m). SBP ne is saal ke liye remittances ka forecast $44 billion se barha kar $45 billion kar diya hai.
pakistan.title: Overseas Pakistanis ne October mein $3.9bn bheje — 14% izafa, saal bhar ka target $45bn

pakistan.summary: Pakistan ne SAFF Championship mein Maldives ko Dhaka mein 3-0 se hara kar semi-final ki taraf qadam barha diya. Najeebullah Bettani ne do goals kiye aur McKeal Aroon Abdullah ne chauthe minute mein penalty se khata khola. Ye jeet India se 3-2 ki opening haar ke baad aayi hai. Ab semi-final ka faisla 11 November ko India-Maldives match par hai — Maldives ko bari jeet chahiye warna Pakistan aur India aage barh jayenge.
pakistan.title: Pakistan ne Maldives ko 3-0 se hara diya — SAFF semi-final ke qareeb

pakistan.summary: Pakistan ki tent-pegging team World Tent-Pegging Championship ke liye Jordan rawana ho gayi hai — championship 11 se 14 November tak hogi. Paanch rukni squad ki qayadat Wajahatullah Khan Awan kar rahe hain, team ne Mianwali mein training camp mukammal kiya. Pakistan 2023 World Cup mein runner-up raha tha.
pakistan.title: Pakistan ki tent-pegging team Jordan rawana — World Championship 11-14 Nov
